subdomain: 3.1 Evaluate tool/agent configuration for capability bloat

en.question: An inventory agent alternates between lookup_stock, stock_lookup_v2, and get_stock_new. Inspection shows that all three expose the same supported backend operation and return the same fields, with no caller requiring their aliases. Wrong-tool selection increased after all three definitions were added. What is the most targeted correction?

options.text: Add a fourth routing tool that asks the model which of the three aliases to invoke.
options.note: A model-selected router preserves the redundant choices and adds another selection step. There is no distinct operation for the aliases to represent.

options.text: Keep all aliases and increase the response token limit for selection reasoning.
options.note: A larger output allowance does not resolve indistinguishable capability definitions. It can add generation time while retaining the source of confusion.

options.text: Load the three definitions earlier and repeat each description in the system prompt.
options.note: Repeating equivalent definitions increases context without adding a useful decision boundary. The observed error is ambiguity between aliases, not missing operation documentation.

options.text: Expose one supported lookup with a clear schema and description, then replay stock-lookup tasks.
options.note: One authoritative interface removes redundant selection choices without losing a required capability. Replaying real tasks verifies that the simplified configuration preserves correct arguments and outcomes.

references.title: Anthropic Engineering: Introducing advanced tool use
